name: Keeper b3: two streets, 29 levels
notes: Table setup: needs a $1 outside minimum and a $1 inside minimum total (rules override limits.outside.min 100, limits.inside.minTotal 100, cents). EV is -2.70% of turnover; this is a skew trade, not an edge. Two streets (1-2-3, 16-17-18) on a 29-step ladder, reset on win, stops at the cap. No cash-out rule. Research ledger e6-full: median $1,679, mean -$321, CVaR5 -$4,491, P(win) 60.8% over 500 spins from $5,000.
